_note: Voice for each speaker's impersonated clips (tools/generate_voice_clips.py). Keys are cast ids from cast.json (or a literal speaker label such as the landing's first mate). "ref": a reference recording of that person (6-30 s of clean speech) under art/voice_refs/ (gitignored: regenerate a missing one from "source" and "span"; "from" names the recording, "captured" is the date its audio was downloaded, and "unknown" marks provenance that was never recorded (release checklist LP-05)), with optional "extra_refs" (more clips of the same person, cut from "extra_spans") passed to XTTS together; "builtin": one of XTTS-v2's built-in studio voices, for characters who aren't real people. Speakers with neither are spoken with system text-to-speech.
